confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and hotel anchors are moderately confident for July, a low-season month when hotel rates tend to be lower. Alcohol anchors (beer, cocktail, wine) are low confidence: alcohol is sold mainly in licensed hotel venues, so an ordinary non-hotel venue serving it is a narrow case. The FX observation came from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates page and a third-party site that reproduces RBA data. I did not open the RBA page directly, so verify the 2026-10-16 value before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Gulf-region basis, priced below Dubai and Doha for comparable tiers. Food and hotel anchors reflect Muscat's ordinary local eateries and registered guesthouses. Cocktail and wine are set relative to the beer anchor (about 1.5x and 1.25x), because direct price knowledge for ordinary licensed venues is weak.
